instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. Indoors against a plain white wall, the blonde woman in the beige hoodie (R2) on the left and the dark-haired woman in the orange hoodie (R1) on the right are turned slightly towards the camera. They high-five with their raised hands while jointly holding a yellow sign that reads "WOMEN'S RIGHTS ARE HUMAN RIGHTS" at waist level. Both women are smiling happily. The scene is illuminated by bright, soft, diffused studio lighting with a neutral color palette.
